matchmaking_summary: CHEF brings forth a wealth of culinary experience and management skills, having held positions ranging from Chef to Chef/Assistant Manager at various companies. With over five years in the industry, CHEF is well-versed in both front-of-house operations and back-of-house responsibilities including menu preparation, banquet services, and sales management. Furthermore, CHEF's educational background in Applied Science - Medical Billing and Coding provides a unique perspective to potential employers seeking someone who not only excels in the culinary realm but is also adept at managing complex administrative tasks.
